tasks.name: Contracts â€” Fork Command + Event Schemas
tasks.description:
Modify `packages/contracts/src/orchestration.ts` to add all fork-related schemas.

### 1. ThreadForkCommand (add after ThreadSessionStopCommand, around line 465)

```typescript
const ThreadForkCommand = Schema.Struct({
  type: Schema.Literal("thread.fork"),
  commandId: CommandId,
  sourceThreadId: ThreadId,
  forkAtMessageId: MessageId,
  threadId: ThreadId,
  projectId: ProjectId,
  title: TrimmedNonEmptyString,
  modelSelection: ModelSelection,
  runtimeMode: RuntimeMode.pipe(Schema.withDecodingDefault(() => DEFAULT_RUNTIME_MODE)),
  interactionMode: ProviderInteractionMode.pipe(
    Schema.withDecodingDefault(() => DEFAULT_PROVIDER_INTERACTION_MODE),
  ),
  branch: Schema.NullOr(TrimmedNonEmptyString),
  worktreePath: Schema.NullOr(TrimmedNonEmptyString),
  createdAt: IsoDateTime,
});
```

### 2. Add ThreadForkCommand to command unions

Add `ThreadForkCommand` to BOTH:
- `DispatchableClientOrchestrationCommand` union array (around line 467)
- `ClientOrchestrationCommand` union array (around line 488)

Do NOT add to `InternalOrchestrationCommand` â€” fork is a client-dispatchable command.

### 3. ThreadForkedPayload (add after existing payload schemas, before OrchestrationEventMetadata)

```typescript
export const ThreadForkedPayload = Schema.Struct({
  threadId: ThreadId,
  projectId: ProjectId,
  sourceThreadId: ThreadId,
  forkAtMessageId: MessageId,
  title: TrimmedNonEmptyString,
  modelSelection: ModelSelection,
  runtimeMode: RuntimeMode.pipe(Schema.withDecodingDefault(() => DEFAULT_RUNTIME_MODE)),
  interactionMode: ProviderInteractionMode.pipe(
    Schema.withDecodingDefault(() => DEFAULT_PROVIDER_INTERACTION_MODE),
  ),
  branch: Schema.NullOr(TrimmedNonEmptyString),
  worktreePath: Schema.NullOr(TrimmedNonEmptyString),
  copiedMessageIds: Schema.Array(MessageId),
  forkNumber: Schema.Number,
  createdAt: IsoDateTime,
  updatedAt: IsoDateTime,
});
```

### 4. Add "thread.forked" to OrchestrationEventType literals

In the `OrchestrationEventType = Schema.Literals([...])` array, add `"thread.forked"` (e.g., after `"thread.unarchived"`).

### 5. Add thread.forked event to OrchestrationEvent union

Add this entry to the `OrchestrationEvent = Schema.Union([...])` array:
```typescript

  ...EventBaseFields,
  type: Schema.Literal("thread.forked"),
  payload: ThreadForkedPayload,
}),
```

### 6. Add forkSource and forks to OrchestrationThread

Add these fields to the `OrchestrationThread = Schema.Struct({...})` schema (after `archivedAt` and before `deletedAt`):
```typescript
forkSource: Schema.optional(Schema.Struct({
  threadId: ThreadId,
  messageId: MessageId,
})),
forks: Schema.Array(Schema.Struct({
  sourceMessageId: MessageId,
  forkedThreadId: ThreadId,
  forkedThreadTitle: TrimmedNonEmptyString,
  forkNumber: Schema.Number,
})).pipe(Schema.withDecodingDefault(() => [])),
```

### 7. Export ThreadForkInfo type

Add after the OrchestrationThread type export:
```typescript
export const ThreadForkInfo = Schema.Struct({
  sourceMessageId: MessageId,
  forkedThreadId: ThreadId,
  forkedThreadTitle: TrimmedNonEmptyString,
  forkNumber: Schema.Number,
});
export type ThreadForkInfo = typeof ThreadForkInfo.Type;
```

IMPORTANT: The `command satisfies never` check in decider.ts means adding to the command union here will cause a type error in the decider until the fork case is handled there. That's expected and will be resolved by a dependent task.

summary_context: Conversation forking feature for T3Code: allows users to fork a thread at any message, creating a new thread with all context up to that point. The feature spans the full stack: a SQLite migration for fork tracking tables, Effect-based command/event schemas in the contracts package, a decider that validates and emits fork events, a projector that creates forked threads with copied messages, and React UI components including a /fork slash command, per-message overflow menus with 'Fork here', and fork badges on source messages linking to forked threads.
